gancho: In the warmth of Kīlauea, the egg Pele carried across the ocean finally cracks, and out comes Hiʻiaka, her youngest and most loved sister. Hiʻiaka grows up among the red lehua forests of Puna, makes a best friend named Hōpoe, and dances what Emerson calls the oldest hula on record. Based on N. B. Emerson, Pele and Hiiaka (1915), and W. D. Westervelt, Hawaiian Legends of Volcanoes (1916).
